prompt:
VISUAL WORLD (identical across all three comps): a premium, minimal, thoughtful wedding-planning website in the spirit of YourDay and Loverly. Warm ivory page ground (#FBF8F3). Deep wine accent (#5E1F33) for the logo mark, primary buttons and small highlights. Soft pastel section washes used sparingly: blush (#F4E4E1) and sage (#E4EAE0). Headlines in a refined, high-contrast editorial serif with one elegant italic accent word; body and UI text in a clean, quiet sans-serif, generous line height. Pill-shaped buttons: primary filled wine with ivory text, secondary thin wine outline. Hairline dividers, very generous whitespace, soft diffused shadows, rounded 16px cards. Calm, romantic, uncluttered; no gradients, no neon, no dark mode, no emoji, no stock icons grid, no sponsor logos, no fake testimonials, no statistics.
Brand: the logo is the word "PlusOne" set in the serif, with "One" in italic wine. Tagline headline text exactly: "Your AI copilot for the perfect wedding."
Crisp, legible, pixel-perfect website UI screenshot, 16:9 desktop viewport 1440x900, flat front-on view, no browser frame, no device mockup, no perspective.
A desktop landing page hero, composition B "editorial split", layout:
1) Top navigation bar: "PlusOne" logo left; links "How it works", "Take the tour", "Sign in" on the right, plus a small filled wine pill "Start planning".
2) Left 45% of the viewport: generous margin, a small wine italic serif line "Plan together, calmly." above a large serif headline stacked on three lines "Your AI copilot for the perfect wedding." (word "perfect" in wine italic); a short sans paragraph "PlusOne researches vendors on the web, writes to them from your own wedding inbox, reads their replies and moves your budget. You make every decision."; then an ivory sign-up card with a hairline border containing two inputs side by side "Email" and "Password", a full-width filled wine pill "Create your wedding", and a small underlined text link "or take the 1-minute tour".
3) Right 55%: a tall, full-height, softly lit editorial wedding photograph with a rounded top-left corner: an elegant reception table with white linen, candles, blush garden roses and greenery, shallow depth of field, natural daylight, warm and airy, no people's faces. Overlapping the photo's lower-left corner, a small ivory card with soft shadow styled like an email: "Reply from Lumen & Lace Photography" with a line "Single Day package: $4,200 · $500 deposit" and a tiny wine pill "Added to budget".
Focal moment: the photograph with its overlapping reply card. Minimal, magazine-like.
